name: Astro
art_prompt: a cheerful young woman astronaut with a slim feminine figure, narrow waist and graceful posture, wearing a fitted white spacesuit with bright orange stripes, orange gloves and chunky orange boots, a round glass bubble helmet with a completely dark tinted mirrored visor that shows no face at all, only faint reflections, a compact white backpack with a round orange air tank, standing straight with hands relaxed at the sides
motion: running in place at a light bouncy jog, arms and legs pumping, backpack bobbing
anim_hint: a slim woman astronaut in a white and orange spacesuit, her round helmet visor is a completely dark opaque black mirror with no face behind it
anim_negative: face, eyes, mouth, hair, a visible face inside the helmet, transparent visor
portrait_prompt: leaning in with a cheerful thumbs-up in an orange glove, the dark mirrored visor of her round helmet reflecting a tiny star and a planet
hurt_hint: her round helmet visor stays a completely dark opaque black mirror with no face behind it, the whole body tensing
trait_text: Gain 2 max HP per level, and heal 8% of max HP on every level-up.
